_about: Programs whose catalog page lists concentrations, emphases, tracks, specializations or pathways of which a student completes ONE. Read by scripts/build_requirements.py; names are matched against the catalog's block and rule names after whitespace is tidied. Each choice gives id, title (the student-facing noun) and pick, and says which requirements belong to which option in one or more of these ways: options[{title, blocks[name | {block, rules?, except?, section?, title?}], section?, empty?}] (explicit); blockRange[first,last] (every block in that range is one option, named after the block); blockPattern (regex on block names with a named group `option` and optionally `section`); rulesIn + rulePattern/skipRules/ruleTitle (each rule of one block is an option). A block listed under several options is repeated under each. The build fails if anything here matches nothing.

major-data-science-ba.why: The catalog says "Domain Emphasis: Students can choose one of the following" and lists the 28 blocks from Aerospace to Urban Science; each block holds that emphasis's lower and upper division courses.

minor-data-science.why: "Students will complete either the DATA 100 Pathway or the Statistics Pathway for their Upper Division requirements."

major-molecular-and-cell-biology-ba.why: "Upper Division Requirements by Emphasis": a student completes one emphasis, and inside most emphases one of two or three tracks. The catalog writes every emphasis/track pair as its own block, so each block is one option.

major-earth-and-planetary-science-ba.why: "one undergraduate major with 6 specializations ... Requirements for each specialization are listed below the core requirements." A second specialization is optional and needs department approval, so one is required.

major-environmental-sciences-bs.why: "Students in this major choose a concentration in biological, physical, or social sciences ... The specific requirements for each concentration are outlined below." Each concentration has its own lower division block and its own elective list.
